messages:
Marisol (People Ops): Quick announcement: for Dec 18-31 were piloting "Winter Flex Days" to help with holiday travel, weather delays, and family needs. Read the changes below and RSVP for any in-office days.

Jon (Eng): Whats the difference between this and regular PTO?

Marisol (People Ops): Not PTO  these are company-sanctioned flexible work days. You can choose to be remote, come in, or use a coworking space and still be counted as available for team coordination. Use the People Ops portal to flag which days youll be remote so managers can plan.

Ava (Facilities): Logistics notes: SF/LON/NYC hubs will keep at least one floor open each day. DeskReserve will allow 21-day holds for Winter Flex; reserved desks for essential on-call staff are prioritized.

Rory (Logistics): Commuter stipend update for pilot period: up to $60/day for transit disruptions or surge fares (was $40). Rideshare receipts required. This applies Dec 18-31 only. If youre driving from outside the metro area, emergency parking vouchers are available  request via the Parking page by Dec 15.

Marisol (People Ops): Visitor policy change for the pilot: external guests are limited on high-volume days (Dec 22-23 and Dec 29-30). If you need to host a partner or family guest on those dates, submit a visitor request by Dec 16 and note reason in the form. Approval required.

Jon (Eng): Childcare support? My partner has shifted travel and we might need evening care.

Marisol (People Ops): Weve expanded the childcare stipend for pilot: up to $200/night for eligible caregivers during the pilot nights (Dec 18-24 & Dec 27-31). Submit requests by Dec 20. Well also provide a quiet family room at each hub on a first-come basis on the 22nd and 29th.

FacilitiesBot: Shuttle adjustments (SF hub) 
```
Dec 21-23: AM runs 07:15/08:00; PM runs 17:00/18:00 (capacity 20)
Dec 28-30: AM runs 08:00 only; PM returns 16:30/18:30 (reserve required)
```
Book via DeskReserve -> "Winter Flex Shuttle" tag. One wheelchair-accessible run per day guaranteed.

Ava (Facilities): Hoteling change: were turning off walk-up kiosks Dec 15 for a security update. Please use DeskReserve or the mobile app. If you need same-day desk due to travel delays, DM Facilities and well try to accommodate.

Rory (Logistics): On-call folks: if you must be onsite but cant make it due to weather or flights, file an exception and well cover last-mile rides up to $100. Coordinate with your manager and log the coverage plan.

Marisol (People Ops): Health & safety: mask-optional in common spaces. If you test positive within 3 days of a scheduled in-office day, please stay home and mark the day remote on the portal; well cover any prepaid travel or coworking costs case-by-case.

Jon (Eng): Any dining changes? I know kitchens get busy.

Marisol (People Ops): Kitchens will be staffed reduced hours on Dec 24 & 31. Well pre-order boxed lunches for hub collab days (22 & 29). If you have allergies, note them on the RSVP.

Ava (Facilities): Accessibility note: if you require a ground-floor desk or elevator access during the pilot, please DM Facilities today. Were holding a small set of reserved accessible desks per hub.

Rory (Logistics): Expense deadline: submit any pilot-related expenses by Jan 15. Use tags: "winter-flex-commute", "winter-flex-childcare", or "winter-flex-cowork". Late claims may be delayed.

CalendarBot: Event created "Winter Flex Days Pilot - Dec 18-31" by Marisol. RSVP required: https://intranet.redwood/office-events/1812109876

Marisol (People Ops): TL;DR: Dec 18-31 Winter Flex Days pilot  flexible remote/in-office/coworking, increased commuter stipend to $60/day, expanded childcare stipend, visitor limits on peak days, DeskReserve required (kiosks offline Dec 15), shuttles adjusted. Please RSVP and ping People Ops with exceptions. :snowflake:
